digest.component_or_area: contribution guidelines and code review documentation
propositions: Authors lack a mechanism to make review holds enforceable; ticket comments and session logs are advisory and invisible to submitters, allowing accidental submission of known-defect changes.
Gerrit's Work In Progress state prevents submission and provides the needed enforcement gate, but no contribution docs mention how to apply it.
Documentation must specify both WIP application paths: git push with %wip at push time and REST POST toggle for existing changes, plus the unmark path.
The rule must be reachable through the packaged `rebar explain review` surface via the guide registry mapping, not just as a file path.
Test coverage must verify the rule's presence across all three surfaces (CONTRIBUTING.md, passing-code-review.md, AGENTS.md) and fail when the rule is removed.
